_nota: Short narrado de las 30 monedas (Mateo 26-27). Nunca se muestra el rostro de Jesús.
m01-monedas: thirty ancient silver coins spilling on a dark wooden table, candlelight, dramatic shadows
m02-judas: a hooded man in a dark ancient tunic walking alone through the narrow stone streets of ancient Jerusalem at night, torchlight
m03-sacerdotes: ancient Jewish priests in white robes and turbans sitting around a table lit by oil lamps, inside a stone hall, at night
m04-balanza: an ancient bronze balance scale weighing silver coins, oil lamp light, dark background
m05-campo: ancient farm workers harvesting wheat in a golden field at sunset, rolling hills
m06-esclavo: an ancient slave in chains seen from behind, standing in a dusty market, dramatic light
m07-profeta: an ancient prophet writing on a scroll by candlelight inside a stone room, seen from behind
m08-arrepentido: a man in an ancient tunic throwing silver coins on the stone floor of a temple courtyard, coins bouncing, torches
m09-alfarero: a rocky field outside ancient Jerusalem walls with broken clay pots on the ground, stormy dusk sky
m10-final: a single ancient silver coin spinning on a dark stone floor, spotlight from above
